content:
An **Intestine** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

The Intestine is a part of the digestive tract of a small animal. It is suitable for making sausages and other consumables which do not require high-quality meat. It is one of the possible items needing to be collected and deposited in the cooler next to the Gleeful Butcher during Event: Fasnacht Day to have a successful event.

Guaranteed drop from squirrels, chickens, Opossums, and rabbits when killed while Fasnacht Day is active. There is only a 60% chance of drop from the same animals when the event is not active.

The use of Butcher's Bounty does not have a chance to award intestines from creatures.
